Who paid back the group gift?

After one person buys the group gift, the three other contributors each owe $40.

  • Anna paid $40 and is settled.
  • Ben paid $35 and still owes $5.
  • Leo paid $0 and still owes $40.

The group has paid $75 and still owes $45. The person who bought the gift keeps the record and updates it as payments arrive.

Track group paybacks in You Owe Me

This kind of record is useful because it separates the original amount from the current balance. That matters when someone pays part of what they owe, repays late, or covers a different expense later.
